Review your plan and limits in ChatGPT.
Sign out and clear the selected model. If disconnection fails, remove the app in ChatGPT settings.
Show answers over other apps. Answers remain in the voice panel without this permission.
Choose Aho! GPT as your default assistant where supported. TV remote shortcuts need a separate button mapper.
Refresh available app actions after installing or updating apps. Some actions may be restricted by Android or the app.
Read answers aloud. Use the gear to choose and test a language or voice. When off, answers appear as text and you can still reply by voice. Speech may use your provider’s online service.
Recognize spoken requests. Use the gear to choose and test a language. Tests do not send requests to OpenAI. Speech may use your provider’s online service.
No voices available. Use the gear to check Android speech settings.
Enable the Google app in Android settings to use speech.
Voice playback is off. Enable TTS in Languages to hear answers.
Enable STT in Languages to speak.

Choose a voice. This does not translate answers.
Hello! This is the Aho! GPT voice test.
Voice test failed. Check Android TTS settings.
Recognition test ended. Tap Test to try again.
Powered by Android speech and OpenAI.

Requests, temporary conversation context and selected app-action results are sent to OpenAI. Optional screen tools may also send visible text, excluding password fields. No chat history is saved.\n\nSpeech providers may process audio or answer text online. Sign-in details are stored securely and excluded from backups. Tokens and screen text stay out of app logs. Provider data policies apply.

Requires a supported ChatGPT account and Android speech services. Models and limits depend on your account. App actions depend on permissions and may fail. Close the voice panel to cancel pending work; actions already sent cannot be undone. This is an unofficial app.

Tap the microphone and speak. After each answer, listening starts automatically for up to eight seconds so you can reply without pressing a button. After silence or an error, the panel closes in three seconds. Tap × to close and cancel pending work. Tap the app logo for settings.
